name: HR Payroll View All Object Status Last Month
query:
SELECT
    ps.object_title AS "Object Title:Data:200",
    ps.status AS "Status:Data:150",
    ps.modified AS "Last Updated:Date:150"
FROM
    `tabProject Setup` ps
WHERE
    (
        (MONTH(ps.modified) = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE)
         AND YEAR(ps.modified) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE))
        OR
        (MONTH(ps.modified) = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
         AND YEAR(ps.modified) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL 1 MONTH))
    )
ORDER BY
    ps.modified DESC;
report_name: HR Payroll View All Object Status Last Month
